summary: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to all landholding farmer families.

steps.title: Farmer land record verification
steps.description: Ensure land ownership record (Jamabandi / RoR / Khatauni) is updated in the farmer's name.

steps.title: Farmer registration on PM-Kisan portal
steps.description: Input Aadhaar, mobile number, land plot survey number, and bank account details.

steps.title: Aadhaar e-KYC authentication
steps.description: Complete mandatory biometric or face e-KYC on PM-Kisan mobile app.

steps.title: State revenue department validation
steps.description: State agriculture/revenue nodal officer validates land records against state land registry.

steps.title: Four-monthly DBT installment credit
steps.description: Receive ₹2,000 direct credit every four months (April-July, August-November, December-March).
